system.description: Starting Move. When you go live from the scene and broadcast a stream to avoid harm and expose your target, roll Edge.

success.value: You get the shot you want and are "escorted" to a position of safety.

partial.value:
You get the shot you want and are "escorted" to a position of safety, but choose one:
• Your story irritates your target (the MC will advance a relevant Threat Clock)
• Someone on your team gets hurt off camera
• Your story angers your employer
• Your rushed narrative is misinterpreted by the public with unintended consequences
